control_flow: avoidWalls: if the light is below 70 %, check the side obstacle sensors (left wall: turn left 20°; right wall: turn right 20°; nothing: call driveInTheDark); in bright light call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the light is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 % without end; in bright light call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if something is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Drive through a tunnel without hitting its walls.

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 70 % (dim, inside a tunnel)

branches.outcome: dim: it checks the side obstacle sensors

decision_points.condition: first: a wall in front of its left half (LEFT); second: a wall in front of its right half (RIGHT)

branches.outcome: LEFT sees a wall: it turns left 20° at 30 %
LEFT sees nothing, RIGHT sees a wall: it turns right 20° at 30 %
neither sees a wall: it calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 70 % (dim, inside a tunnel)

branches.outcome: dim: it drives forward at 30 % without end
nothing is ahead: it calls followLine
black: it curves left (left wheel 10 %, right wheel 40 %)
not black: it curves right (left wheel 40 %, right wheel 10 %)

scenarios.coded_response: In dim light it drives straight on at 30 % while no wall is seen; when the left sensor sees a wall it turns left 20°, when the right sensor sees one it turns right 20°.
scenarios.initial_condition: On a line that runs into a tunnel, in bright light: the robot follows the line inside, into the dim light. The tunnel is straight, or it bends to the right (its left wall comes in front of the left half) or to the left (its right wall comes in front of the right half).
scenarios.trigger: The light falls below 70 % under the tunnel's roof; in a bend, one of the tunnel's walls comes in front of a half of the robot.
scenarios.title: Drives through a tunnel without hitting its walls
assumptions: You didn't say where the robot should get to: the test takes it that it drives on through the tunnel.

In bright light the program follows a line and stops at a wall ahead; you didn't say what it should do there.
